description: Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka - Notifying that Sakurai Aviation Limited seeking an Air Operator Certificate/Airline Licence to engage in Domestic Scheduled Operations, Charter Operations and Aerial Work to engage in Domestic Operations
categorisation: This gazette notice is about a commercial application for an Air Operator Certificate/Airline Licence from a private company (Sakurai Aviation Limited) to engage in domestic scheduled operations, charter operations, and aerial work. It involves business registration, commercial licensing, and regulatory compliance for aviation operations, which falls under business and commercial matters.
